name: beartype-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is beartype, a pure-Python runtime type checker: the `@beartype` decorator and its
`BeartypeConf` configuration, the `beartype.door` API for type-checking objects against type hints and comparing
type hints at any time, the `beartype.roar` exceptions and warnings, and the `beartype.vale` validators.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is beartype's public decoration, configuration, introspection, exception and validator API: the module beartype/__init__.py, the packages beartype/_conf/, beartype/door/, beartype/roar/ and beartype/vale/, and every module of the decorator package beartype/_decor/ except its wrapper code generator beartype/_decor/_nontype/_wrap/; together with docs/api.md, docs/api_decor.md, docs/api_door.md, docs/api_roar.md, docs/api_vale.md and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.
